Task: Explain why the sky appears blue, in three sentences.

steps.action:
The sky appears blue because of a phenomenon called Rayleigh scattering, in which sunlight interacts with gas molecules in Earth's atmosphere. Sunlight contains all colors of the visible spectrum, but shorter wavelengths of light — particularly blue — are scattered much more efficiently in all directions than longer wavelengths like red and orange. As a result, when you look anywhere in the sky (away from the sun), your eyes receive this scattered blue light from all directions, making the sky appear blue.
